processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: The volume fraction of retained austenite decreased from 79.1% to 33.4% with hot rolling temperature increasing from 650 °C to 800 °C.

structures.overall_structure: Retained austenite-containing microstructure; the volume fraction of retained austenite decreased from 79.1% to 33.4% with hot rolling temperature increasing from 650 °C to 800 °C, followed by tempering at 200 °C.

unmapped_findings: Zhang et al.[45] systematically studied the hot rolling and tempering treatment effects on the microstructure evolution of Fe–12.4Mn–2.4Al–0.1C (wt%) low-density steel; the review reports only the retained austenite volume fraction change (79.1% to 33.4%) for this sample.
